page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sn2ne.14xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server powered by an Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processor running at 2.5 GHz. It features 56 dedicated physical cores with 1.0 thread per core and 224.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced 4.0 GB of RAM per core. This KVM-hypervised instance does not include local storage or GPU accelerators, relying instead on network-attached storage and offering a baseline network bandwidth of 10 Gbps.

Performance benchmarks indicate a clear distinction between single-core and multi-core capabilities. Single-core performance is relatively weak, as shown by stress-ng and Geekbench single-core scores falling into the bottom 25 percent, and single-threaded gzip compression categorized in the bottom 10 percent. However, the high core count enables average multi-core performance across stress-ng, Geekbench, and Passmark CPU tests. Memory bandwidth for both cached and uncached reads and writes remains in the middle 50 percent tier, alongside average performance in Redis SET operations and static web serving.

Given its dedicated 56-core configuration and balanced memory-to-CPU ratio, this server is positioned for multi-threaded workloads that can exploit parallel processing despite modest single-thread speeds. It is suitable for general-purpose enterprise applications, multi-threaded decompression tasks, and moderate database operations. From a cost-efficiency perspective, the hardware profile offers a high density of dedicated physical cores and standard memory capacity, making it a viable option for parallelized workloads that do not require local SSD storage or GPU acceleration.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sn2ne.14xlarge is a general-purpose, KVM-hypervised server configured with 56 dedicated physical cores on an Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processor running at 2.5 GHz. It features 224.0 GB of RAM, yielding a balanced 4.0 GB per core, with no local storage or GPU accelerators. The instance provides a baseline network bandwidth of 10 Gbps. Benchmark data shows weak single-core performance, with single-threaded compression and Geekbench single-core scores in the lower percentiles. Conversely, multi-core benchmarks, including stress-ng multi-core, Passmark CPU, and multi-threaded bzip3 decompression, fall into the average tier. This server is best suited for parallelized, multi-threaded workloads such as general-purpose enterprise applications, web serving, and database operations that benefit from a high core count but do not demand high single-thread execution speeds.
